title: [CQ-R10d3a] Guest supervisor agents install mode
definitionOfDone: The 'agents' mode installs every streamed binary at <agents>/<cli> as 0555 (root:root in production; the owner is a test seam), only after its size and sha256 match its header. It answers one {kind:'installed', count} frame and replaces an older install atomically. Shown by tests through the real supervisor under python3.

Each refusal exits 65 with no frame, no installed file and no staging directory left: an unknown or non-string cli, a duplicate, a size or hash mismatch, a malformed or overlong data frame, an empty stream, EOF before end, a frame after end, and a valid binary followed by a bad one. An agents path that is a symlink exits 74. Shown by tests.
main accepts ['agents'] (77 when not root, 64 with extra arguments) and runs install_agents(0, 1) with its fixed defaults. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
